scenes.picture: Chidi holding a glass of red wine, trying to be romantic for his wife in the living room.
scenes.dialogue: Babe, see as I romantic today!
scenes.caption: Chidi wan use red wine impress im wife.

scenes.picture: Chidi tripping over the rug as Aunty Ngozi walks in carrying heavy groceries, screaming.
scenes.dialogue: Chineke mo! Wetin you dey do?
scenes.caption: Aunty Ngozi enter just in time for disaster.

scenes.picture: The red wine splashing through the air, heading straight for Aunty Ngozi's expensive white lace wrapper.
scenes.caption: The wine find fresh target sharply.

scenes.picture: Aunty Ngozi crying over the giant red stain on her wrapper while Chidi sweats profusely.
scenes.dialogue: Chidi, na this cloth I wan wear go church tomorrow o!
scenes.caption: Church dress don turn abstract art.

scenes.picture: Chidi trying to scrub the stain with sponge and ordinary dish soap, making it spread wider.
scenes.dialogue: Wait, make I use Mama Lemon clean am... ah, e dey spread!
scenes.caption: Local method make the matter worse.

scenes.picture: Neat Naija attendant in a neat green uniform smiling and handing back the spotless wrapper to a relieved Aunty Ngozi and Chidi.
scenes.dialogue: Relax, leave the heavy lifting for Neat Naija.
scenes.caption: Miracle workers don land. Laundry, house, office, sofa and carpet cleaning. DM to book.
